name: sip_expiry_query
description: RM asks which clients have SIPs expiring soon

conversation.content: Which of my clients have SIPs expiring in the next 30 days?

reference: The agent should list clients whose SIPs expire within 30 days, including fund name, monthly amount, and expiry date.

criteria.contains_fund_name: Response must mention the mutual fund name
criteria.contains_inr_amounts: Response must show SIP amount in rupees
criteria.suggests_action: Response should suggest contacting the client or drafting a renewal

name: sip_renewal_email_draft
description: RM asks to draft a SIP renewal email for a specific client

conversation.content: Draft a SIP renewal email for client C0001

reference: The agent should fetch the client's SIP details, draft a professional Hindi-English email, and stage it for RM approval. The draft must NOT be sent automatically.

criteria.draft_not_sent: Status must be pending_rm_approval, not sent
criteria.email_has_subject: Draft must include a subject line
criteria.email_has_client_name: Email must be personalized with client name
criteria.email_mentions_fund: Email must mention the fund name and amount
criteria.asks_for_approval: Agent must ask RM to approve before sending

name: sip_renewal_call_approval
description: RM asks to call a client about SIP renewal

conversation.content: Call Rahul about his SIP renewal

reference: Agent fetches client data, builds Hindi call script with live SIP details, stages the call for RM approval. Call must NOT be initiated automatically.

criteria.call_not_auto_initiated: Call must be staged for approval, not auto-dialed
criteria.script_in_hindi: Call script context should be in Hindi
criteria.shows_approve_button: Response must offer an approval action
criteria.includes_client_mobile: Response should confirm the mobile number to be called
